page.content:
Young mathematician who meets Seldon on Trantor.

How Gaal Dornick connects

  • Work: Foundation (book) — Gaal Dornick is the first book's viewpoint mathematician.
  • Faction: First Foundation — Gaal is drawn into Seldon's Foundation project.

What is Gaal Dornick?

Gaal Dornick arrives from Synnax to work with Seldon, witnesses the trial, and becomes the reader's first eyes on psychohistory and Terminus.

Key threads lead to Foundation (book) and First Foundation.
